discover.q: have/has + 과거분사 문장을 보세요. 계속, 완료, 경험, 결과는 각각 어떤 말(for, already, ever, yet)과 함께 쓰였나요? yesterday와 함께 쓸 수 있나요?
discover.a: 계속은 for/since, 완료는 already/yet, 경험은 ever/never와 함께 쓴다. yesterday, ago 같은 과거 시점 표현과는 함께 쓰지 않는다.

choose.p: I have ____ here for ten years.
She has already ____ lunch.

I ____ him yesterday.
We ____ finished yet.
choose.why: yet과 함께 쓰는 완료의 부정은 haven't입니다.

choose.p: He ____ just finished his homework.
They have ____ each other since 2020.
I ____ that movie last night.
choose.why: last night과 같은 명백한 과거 시점 표현이 있으면 과거시제를 씁니다.

choose.p: My brother has ____ his leg.
____ you ever tried Mexican food?
choose.why: 과거분사(tried)와 함께 경험을 묻는 현재완료 의문문은 Have로 시작합니다.

correct.why: yesterday가 있으면 과거시제를 씁니다.

correct.w: Have you ever went there?

correct.why: have 뒤에는 과거분사를 씁니다.

correct.w: She have already eaten lunch.
correct.r: She has already eaten lunch.
correct.why: She에는 has를 씁니다.

correct.w: I have bought a new bike two days ago.
correct.r: I bought a new bike two days ago.

correct.w: He have studied English for three years.
correct.r: He has studied English for three years.
correct.why: 주어가 3인칭 단수(He)일 때는 have가 아니라 has를 씁니다.

correct.w: Have you ever ate Thai food?
correct.r: Have you ever eaten Thai food?
correct.why: Have 뒤에는 동사원형이나 과거형이 아닌 과거분사를 써야 합니다.
